title:Gene set enrichment results from ERAP2 KD proteomics
output:pdf_document

### Main questions

We set out to understand the role of hypoxia in astrocytes.


### 1.0 Package requirements

- change to current working directory `/data/shared/lab_internal/012-Ben-Clarke-ERAP1-KD/analysis` and include required packages

```{r include = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}

setwd("/data/shared/lab_internal/012-Ben-Clarke-ERAP1-KD/analysis")
require("stringr")
require("DESeq2")
require("PCAtools")
require("rtracklayer")
require("stringr")
# require("ggvenn")
require("cowplot")
require("ggplot2")
require("ggrepel")

```

- Set paths

```{r}

analysis_path <- "14-erap2-kd-proteomics/"
save_dir <- file.path(analysis_path, "rdata_files")
plot_dir <- file.path(analysis_path, "plots")
input_dir <- file.path(analysis_path, "input_files")
output_dir <- file.path(analysis_path, "output_files")

dir.create(save_dir)
dir.create(plot_dir)
dir.create(input_dir)
dir.create(output_dir)

```



### Load annotation file

- Load ensembl annotation gtf

```{r include = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}

require("rtracklayer")
annotation_gtf <- "/data/shared/public_datasets/Genomes/ENSEMBL_hg38/Homo_sapiens.GRCh38.104.chr_patch_hapl_scaff.gtf"
annotation_ranges <- import.gff2(annotation_gtf)
annotation_gene_ranges <- annotation_ranges[annotation_ranges$type == "gene"]

```

- Load ERAP2 KD proteomics

```{r}

differential_protein_enrichment_list <- readRDS(file.path(save_dir, "02-02-rots-differential-enrichment-analysis-results.rds"))
unimputed_effect_df <- differential_protein_enrichment_list$unimputed_data
imputed_effect_df <- do.call(rbind, differential_protein_enrichment_list$minprob_default_imputed_data)

```

- The imputed and unimputed data have very considerable overlaps, we consider the union of both

```{r}

significant_events_df <- readRDS(file.path(save_dir, "02-03-significantly-affected-proteins.rds"))

```

- Plot volcano without thresholding on log foldchange

```{r}

imputed_effect_df$direction[imputed_effect_df$logfc < 0 ] <- "down"
imputed_effect_df$direction[imputed_effect_df$logfc > 0 ] <- "up"

imputed_effect_df$fdr[imputed_effect_df$fdr == 0] <- 0.001
imputed_effect_df$log_fdr <- -log10(imputed_effect_df$fdr)
imputed_effect_df$log_pvalue <- -log10(imputed_effect_df$pvalue)


significant_events_df$fdr[significant_events_df$fdr == 0] <- 0.001
significant_events_df$log_fdr <- -log10(significant_events_df$fdr)
significant_events_df$log_pvalue <- -log10(significant_events_df$pvalue)

direction_colours <- c("down" = "#009FB7", "up" = "#FF6978")
sig_colours <- c("imputed" = "#FAB2EA", "unimputed" = "#7E2E84", "both" = "#EE6C4D")


current_theme <- theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    text = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
    plot.background = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "azure3",
    linetype = "dashed",
    size = 0.2))


unique(imputed_effect_df[
    imputed_effect_df$pvalue < 0.05 & 
    imputed_effect_df$protein_name %in% c(astrocyte_marker_genes, reactivity_marker_genes, escartin_marker_genes) & 
    imputed_effect_df$comparison %in% c("VCP_ERAP2_vs_VCP_CTRL", "CTRL_ERAP2_vs_CTRL_CTRL"), "protein_name"])



ThePlot <- ggplot(imputed_effect_df[imputed_effect_df$comparison %in% c("VCP_ERAP2_vs_VCP_CTRL", "CTRL_ERAP2_vs_CTRL_CTRL") & 
    imputed_effect_df$protein_name %in% astrocyte_marker_genes,], 
    aes(x = logfc, y = log_pvalue))
ThePlot <- ThePlot + geom_point(fill = "#F6F3FE", colour = "#000000", shape = 21, alpha = 0.4)
# ThePlot <- ThePlot + geom_point(data = significant_events_df[significant_events_df$comparison %in% c("VCP_CTRL_vs_CTRL_CTRL", "VCP_ERAP2_vs_CTRL_ERAP2"),], 
#     aes(fill = sig_group), colour = "#000000", shape = 21)
ThePlot <- ThePlot + geom_text_repel(data = imputed_effect_df[
    imputed_effect_df$protein_name %in% astrocyte_marker_genes & 
    imputed_effect_df$comparison %in% c("VCP_ERAP2_vs_VCP_CTRL", "CTRL_ERAP2_vs_CTRL_CTRL"),], 
    aes(label = protein_name), box.padding = 0.8, point.padding = 0.3, max.overlaps = Inf, size = 2)
ThePlot <- ThePlot + geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "#000000", lty = "dashed")
ThePlot <- ThePlot + geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), colour = "#000000", lty = "dashed")
ThePlot <- ThePlot + scale_x_continuous("log2 fold change")
ThePlot <- ThePlot + scale_y_continuous("-log10(pvalue)")
# ThePlot <- ThePlot + scale_fill_manual("significance group", values = sig_colours)
ThePlot <- ThePlot + theme_bw()
ThePlot <- ThePlot + ggtitle("volcano plot of comparisons")
ThePlot <- ThePlot + facet_grid(. ~ comparison, scales = "free")
ThePlot <- ThePlot + current_theme
ggsave(width = 10, height = 7, file = file.path(plot_dir, "100-01-genome-medicine-rebuttal-analysis-volcano-plot-of-comparisons-highlight-astrocyte-markers.pdf"), ThePlot)


ThePlot <- ggplot(imputed_effect_df[imputed_effect_df$comparison %in% c("VCP_ERAP2_vs_VCP_CTRL", "CTRL_ERAP2_vs_CTRL_CTRL") & 
    imputed_effect_df$protein_name %in% reactivity_marker_genes,], 
    aes(x = logfc, y = log_pvalue))
ThePlot <- ThePlot + geom_point(fill = "#F6F3FE", colour = "#000000", shape = 21, alpha = 0.4)
# ThePlot <- ThePlot + geom_point(data = significant_events_df[significant_events_df$comparison %in% c("VCP_CTRL_vs_CTRL_CTRL", "VCP_ERAP2_vs_CTRL_ERAP2"),],
```
